## IconButton.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `icon` :: The icon drawn in the button.
- `label` :: The accessible name. Required, because the button has no visible text; it is also announced as the tooltip text.
- `variant` :: The visual style.
- `size` :: The control height; the button is always square.
- `textSize` :: The text/icon scale, independent of the control height.
- `textColor` :: The icon colour. Defaults to `text-inverse` on dark variants, `text-primary` on light ones.
- `shape` :: The corner shape.
- `loading` :: Shows a spinner in place of the icon and blocks interaction.
- `href` :: Renders an `<a>` that looks like an icon button. Use for navigation.
- `target` :: Where to open the link, when `href` is set.
- `pressable` :: Springs the button down under the pointer. Turn off for a still button.
- `disabled` :: Blocks pointer and keyboard input, and drops `href` on a link.
